title: Trust you can see: every draft card shows its lane's track record, a second check, the rows behind it and a receipt, and lanes switch off one by one
description: The master plan's fourth hard pass (2026-11-11), from the 2026 human-AI teaming study: confidence scores were right about half the time, agreement between two checks and evidence links helped, and people muted bad AI too late. A draft's lane is "<channel>:<hunt_id>" ("<channel>:all" without a hunt). Every draft gains trust { lane, record { approved, rejected, regrets }, second_check, evidence }: the record is counted from the flow's other drafts in that lane, evidence lists their ids, and second_check is agree, disagree or null when no cheap second check ran. A draft that went out gains receipt { at, channel, to, body_sha256 }; one that has not has receipt null. Lanes switch off one at a time (POST /v1/supervisor/flows/{key}/lanes/{lane}/off and /on, GET .../lanes); approving a draft in a lane that is off answers 409 and changes nothing. No confidence percentages anywhere on a card. The cheap second check itself (a smaller model or a rule pass) is a later row; until then second_check is null. Wave 2 of the master plan v2.
acceptance: Each draft's trust record counts its lane only, lists its evidence, and holds no percentage or confidence figure
A draft marked sent carries a receipt whose body_sha256 matches its body; a waiting draft has receipt null
Switching one lane off blocks approvals in that lane only (409, no outbox write); no session 401
